name: Meowth
description: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in a cute way, making the foe lower its ATTACK stat.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The user bites with vicious fangs. It may make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Pay Day
moves.description: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe. Money is earned after battle.

moves.name: Feint Attack
moves.description: The user draws up close to the foe disarmingly, then hits without fail.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s DEFENSE.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.description: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description: An attack that hits first and causes flinching. Usable only on 1st turn.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: A move that makes the foe confused, but also sharply raises its ATTACK.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: A basic attack. It can be used to cut down thin trees and grass.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electrical attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: A blast of light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It also illuminates caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: An attack that may take the foe’s held item if the user isn’t holding one.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its TRAINER.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its TRAINER.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: An attack with a steel-hard tail. It may lower the foe’s DEFENSE stat.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: An attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the user.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up WATER- type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up FIRE-type moves.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May also lower the foe’s SP. DEF.

moves.name: Torment
moves.description: It enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move successively.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.description: Steals the effects of the foe’s healing or status- changing move.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can’t be evaded.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. It can’t be evaded.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: An attack with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life- risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.description: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: Forgets about something and sharply raises SP. DEF.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: A move that cuts 2 to 5 PP from the move last used by the foe.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The foe is charmed by the user’s cute appeals, sharply cutting its ATTACK.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Assist
moves.description: The user randomly picks and uses a move of an allied POKéMON.
